law_name: Loi relative a l'industrie verte (Green Industry Law)
description: As Minister Delegate for Industry, Lescure was the government's lead figure carrying the Green Industry Law, co-constructed at Bercy from early 2023 through thematic working groups. Adopted in first reading by the National Assembly on 22 July 2023 (Senate adopted its version 22 June 2023).
significance: Aimed to decarbonise existing French industry (about 18% of national CO2 emissions) and accelerate production of green technologies, including faster industrial-site permitting and green-investment incentives.

law_name: Privatisation of Groupe ADP (Aeroports de Paris) - PACTE law provisions
description: As President of the National Assembly Economic Affairs Committee, Lescure served as parliamentary rapporteur on the planned privatisation of Groupe ADP, a flagship and contested element of the 2019 PACTE framework. The privatisation was ultimately shelved.
significance: One of the most politically contested economic measures of the 2017-2022 legislature; opposition MPs launched a shared-initiative referendum (RIP) procedure against it.
